scenes.title: Open relationship
scenes.summary: Max arrives at Vika's apartment drunk in the middle of the night.

scenes.title: New names
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov misses Senya and Fedya, who were fired, and renames the two new cooks: Artyom must be Senya for the day, and a new cook who is also called Fedya is told he has to earn that name and becomes Artyom.

scenes.title: Interrogation again
scenes.summary: Kostya finds Max at home in the morning; Max is on the second shift, and Kostya admits he was fired.

scenes.title: Tour for Igor
scenes.summary: Owner Dmitry Nagiyev is giving a grand tour of his restaurant to his friend Igor.

scenes.title: Saying Goodbye
scenes.summary: Igor thanks Vika for the tour and says a polite goodbye.

scenes.title: The Guest's Question
scenes.summary: Igor asks Vika whether she is free, and Max is hurt that she didn't mention him.

scenes.title: The Bouquet
scenes.summary: Max brings Vika a small gift, then a courier delivers a huge bouquet for her.

scenes.title: The New Plan
scenes.summary: Kostya tries to calm Max down about the rival bouquet.

scenes.title: Return of the Cooks
scenes.summary: Viktor calls his fired cook Fedya to persuade him to return to Claude Monet, bluffing that Senya has already agreed to rejoin the kitchen staff.

scenes.title: A Suspicious Guest
scenes.summary: In the restaurant hall, Max spots Victoria talking with an unfamiliar customer holding flowers and asks Kostya to go over and find out what they are discussing.

scenes.title: Espionage at the Bar
scenes.summary: Kostya reports back to Max about Victoria conversation with the client, revealing that they are leaving together for a business meeting.

scenes.title: Jealousy in the Parking Lot
scenes.summary: In the parking lot outside Claude Monet, Victoria catches Max spying on her and clarifies that the client is a potential buyer for the restaurant.

scenes.title: The Cripples
scenes.summary: Max, Senya, and Fedya take a break and argue about who is more professional in the kitchen.

scenes.title: The Restaurant's Birthday
scenes.summary: Vika asks Chef about his plan to save the restaurant. The Chef reveals his idea to celebrate the restaurant's birthday.

scenes.title: The Sponsor and the Oligarch
scenes.summary: The Chef fails his TV ad shoot by not mentioning the sponsor, but tells Vika he has booked a table for the famous oligarch Prokhor Mikhailov.

scenes.title: Selling the Restaurant
scenes.summary: Dima complains that security turned away a famous socialite. He reveals that he is trying to sell the restaurant.

scenes.title: My Girlfriend
scenes.summary: Kristina returns early and accuses Dima of seeing Vika. Max lies and says Vika is his girlfriend to save Dima.

scenes.title: The Confession
scenes.summary: Max tells Vika that he does not want an open relationship.

scenes.title: The Answer
scenes.summary: Max asks if Vika agrees to be his girlfriend.

scenes.title: Doubts
scenes.summary: Max reflects on how people value what they have.

scenes.title: Together
scenes.summary: Max says that the main thing is that they are together.

scenes.title: Here and Now
scenes.summary: Max concludes that it is important to cherish the present.
